title: Model Health Cockpit: interactive per-model & per-route performance charts + chart specs
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design an integrated 'Model Health Cockpit' for Redwood Console to give engineers and product teams a single-pane view for per-model and per-route performance. The cockpit combines latency and throughput trends, token metrics (input/output, cost), KV cache and batching efficiency, and rollout annotations so teams can quickly determine whether a model/version/route is meeting SLOs and where to investigate. Deliverables: high-fidelity Figma flows, detailed chart specs for engineering, and interaction patterns for version compare and rollout context.
acceptance_criteria: Cockpit mockups cover model-level overview and route-level drilldowns
Chart specs include aggregation windows, axes units, needed percentiles, and recommended default time ranges
Interaction patterns for model-version compare and rollout annotation overlay are documented
Design includes low-fidelity table and row-sparkline comps to surface hot routes
Figma prototype linked for developer handoff and a single engineering ticket created with spec attachments
proposed_components: Overview header: model selector, version selector, route filter, time range quick presets (1h/6h/24h/7d/30d)
Primary metric row: P50/P90/P95/P99 latency line chart + stacked throughput area (rps)
Token economics panel: median input tokens, median output tokens, median cost per request, cost trend sparkline
Efficiency metrics: KV cache hit rate gauge, average batching factor chart
Route table with inline sparklines, per-route 95th latency, rps, error rate, and quick actions (open route, compare versions)
Rollout timeline strip: chronological markers for deployments/canaries, hover reveals PR/commit and percent rollout
Compare mode: dual-axis overlay and side-by-side small multiples for two model versions or routes
Annotation layer: pin incident notes or config changes to timelines for context
chart_specs: Latency summary (line): series = P50, P95, P99; Y-axis units = milliseconds; default aggregation = 1m for <24h, 5m for 24h-7d, 1h for >7d; smoothing = optional toggle; tooltip shows exact percentiles and sample count
Throughput (area + line): series = requests_per_sec (area), tokens_per_sec (line); Y-axis left = rps, right = tokens/sec; stackable by route when grouped; aggregation as above
Token distribution (box/violin): per-request input/output token distribution; show median, IQR, min/max; useful for spotting payload regressions
Cost per request (bar + moving avg): bars = median cost per request by minute; overlay = rolling 1h mean; currency display with per-token breakdown on hover
KV cache hit rate (sparkline + percentage): single series 0-100%; show absolute hits and miss counts on tooltip
Batching efficiency (histogram): x-axis = batch size, y-axis = frequency; derived metric = average tokens per batch; useful for tuning batching configs
Error rate (stacked area): 4xx vs 5xx; show count and percent of total requests; support anomaly coloring when sudden spike detected
SLO banding: optional shaded region on latency charts showing acceptable P95 threshold with color transitions when crossed

2025-02-20: Incorporated feedback to expose 'Compare versions' CTA and rollout scrubber. Added accessibility notes for color contrast and tooltip keyboard navigation. Marked ready for review.

Priya Desai (Observability ENG) - 2025-02-17: Need to confirm how we compute batch factor — current logs only have aggregated batch counts at 5m. ENG-2138 will add finer granularity.
Samir Rao (ENG) - 2025-02-18: For long time ranges we should offer a sampling mode to avoid heavy queries. Also prefer percentiles over raw p99 for small sample counts.
